scope: Primary-source documentation research. No authenticated Ompra connection or account operation was performed. Configuration references require adaptation to OMP's package schema.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.authentication: Hosted service requires OAuth; generic HTTP MCP clients are documented. Dynamic client registration and the complete Ompra authorization/refresh flow still require verification.
entries.runtime: Hosted HTTP does not require a separate local runtime.
limitations: Scope the endpoint to a chosen organization/project where possible.
Account permissions and service terms apply.
Do not mark connected until authenticated discovery and a permitted tool call pass in Ompra.

entries.name: PostHog
entries.authentication: A personal API key as Authorization Bearer is documented for native HTTP clients. The hosted edge also serves OAuth discovery; Ompra OAuth/DCR compatibility has not been verified.
entries.runtime: Hosted HTTP does not require mcp-remote or a separate Node runtime when the host supports native HTTP.
capabilities: Work with feature flags and error tracking
limitations: Use least-privilege personal API key scopes and selected feature/tool groups.
The default service surface can expose a single CLI-like exec tool rather than many tools; verify the actual discovery response.
Hosted service terms and project permissions apply; a wrapper license does not license the service.
Self-hosted PostHog is a separate setup path; the cloud URL is not a proxy to arbitrary private instances.
